title: Theatre Workshop
modules: History Of The Theatre: The Modern
mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a kind of performative examination."
Audition is a kind of performative examination.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a dominant aspect of the theatre today."
Playwriting is a dominant aspect of the theatre today.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a fascinating human art, an art that requires versatile skills and talents."
Theatre is a fascinating human art, an art that requires versatile skills and talents.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to a particular stage dress worn during a particular historical era."
Period costume refers to a particular stage dress worn during a particular historical era.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a theatre of reason, not the type that evokes emotion."
Epic theatre is a theatre of reason, not the type that evokes emotion.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is used to describe staging arrangement that tends towards the symbolic."
Theatricalism is used to describe staging arrangement that tends towards the symbolic.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the goddess of creativity, the source of creative inspiration."
Muse in a nutshell is the goddess of creativity, the source of creative inspiration.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the summit of all the sciences because the goal of all knowledge is the health of society."
Comte opines that Sociology is the summit of all the sciences because the goal of all knowledge is the health of society.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an invaluable aspect of theatre practice."
Directing is an invaluable aspect of theatre practice.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a period of artistic integration."
Technical and dress rehearsal is a period of artistic integration.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the starting point of a successful and interesting play."
A sound plot is the starting point of a successful and interesting play.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a rule which demands that all the actions of the play must be such that are capable of taking place within a single day."
Unity of time is a rule which demands that all the actions of the play must be such that are capable of taking place within a single day.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ means of gaining knowledge of human history and cultural movements."
Scenery can be a means of gaining knowledge of human history and cultural movements.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a major instrument of playwriting."
Character is a major instrument of playwriting.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to the art of painting scenic environment in a way that gives an impression of the object's right height, size, width and depth as it appears from a distance."
Perspective painting refers to the art of painting scenic environment in a way that gives an impression of the object's right height, size, width and depth as it appears from a distance.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the type of costume made to suit the shape of the body of the wearer."
The fitted costume is the type of costume made to suit the shape of the body of the wearer.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is used to communicate ideas, delineate characters, clarify mood, reveal thought, describe the play's atmosphere and environment, as well as kindle emotion."
Language is used to communicate ideas, delineate characters, clarify mood, reveal thought, describe the play's atmosphere and environment, as well as kindle emotion.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the key "architectural feature through which the audience views the performance at some distance, psychological, as well as physically" (Albright et al, 147)."
The proscenium arch is the key "architectural feature through which the audience views the performance at some distance, psychological, as well as physically" (Albright et al, 147).
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the source and origin of design."
Improvisation implies that the person is the source and origin of design.

stage
